title: Becoming Open Context
description: Captured when a metamorphosis starts — what we are trying to become and which inputs/injects feed it.

from.description: Fully-qualified class name of the being being transformed from.

be.description: Target class for the next metamorphosis. Single FQCN, or pipe-joined FQCNs when the attribute declares multiple candidates.

input.description: Map of #[Input] parameter names to their origin path on the previous being.

inject.description: Map of #[Inject] parameter names to the interface / service identifier resolved from the DI container.
